title: Chapter 56
content_en: MGA: Chapter 56 – Those Who Dare Approach, DieChu Feng and the others followed the map and continued walking. Finally, before the sky became dark, they arrived at the so-called tomb.At that instant, the tomb was already opened. Although there were still a lot of people rushing in, they could not see the figures of the Origin realm experts. Which meant that the strongest people already entered.“So we can only get some leftovers?” Seeing that scene, many people were discouraged.“If we don’t quickly enter, I’m afraid that we won’t even see a single grain of rice.” On the other hand, Chu Feng smiled indifferently and took the lead to rush in first.The tomb was created under the desert and the size exceeded everyone’s imagination.
